approvers: Owner/director; client or developer would have to accept the extra cost
reason: We spend about €1,461 a year on snagging damage, and at €19 per m² this would cost many times that. I buy on cost per m² and film and tape cost well under €1/m², so I can't justify it.
objection: €19/m² is far more than our damage costs us. A new supplier also needs documents, insurance and a credit application, and it wants a 50% deposit. In July and August half the façade is in full sun, so when would you even apply it?
instead: Keep going with no protection, or cheap film and tape on the few frames at risk, and pay for cleaning or replacement at snagging from the job contingency.
would_change_my_mind: A price near film-and-tape level, or a client or developer who pays for it as a specified item.
